subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should the Companion keep a stable, setup-proven OpenClaw package as its default, or intentionally send all new default installations to `2026.7.2-beta.2`?
rationale: The current branch, PR description, canonical issue, and proof record encode conflicting release contracts; only a maintainer can authorize prerelease-by-default support policy.

options.title: Restore stable default
options.body: Pin a stable OpenClaw release, keep beta validation separate, and merge only after the selected stable package completes the official WSL2 setup path.

options.title: Approve beta default
options.body: Explicitly adopt prerelease-by-default behavior, align the body, documentation, and tests, and provide successful beta WSL2 setup and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for next stable
options.body: Pause until the upstream Gateway fix ships in a stable release, then retarget the LKG and rerun the full official-package setup proof.

recommendation.title: Restore stable default
recommendation.body: Pin a stable OpenClaw release, keep beta validation separate, and merge only after the selected stable package completes the official WSL2 setup path.

likelyOwner.reason: Among the available history signals, this person has the strongest recent overlap with Gateway connection, pairing, and Companion behavior affected by the release choice.
